sources.title: Slovak MFA: countries Slovak citizens may visit without a visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The Slovak MFA's current outward-travel list expressly gives country-by-country visa-free stays for Slovak citizens, including Belize.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Botswana entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The Slovakia MFA country page, updated 4 November 2024, specifies visitor entry conditions for Slovak nationals and links Botswana's government portal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občania Slovenskej republiky ... nepotrebujú na vstup do Botswany vízum na dobu 30 dní.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Panama entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The Slovakia MFA country page, updated 30 June 2025, directly states ordinary Slovak-passport tourism rules for Panama.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občan Slovenskej republiky ... môže do Panamy cestovať bez víz za účelom turistiky ... 90 dní.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Tunisia entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The Slovakia MFA page, updated 13 April 2025, directly states the ordinary Slovak-passport short-visitor rule for Tunisia.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občania Slovenskej republiky víza na vstup do Tuniska nepotrebujú. Maximálna dĺžka pobytu bez víza je 90 dní.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Ukraine entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The Slovakia MFA country page was updated 25 June 2026 and directly states the visa requirement for Slovak nationals entering Ukraine.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občania Slovenskej republiky nepotrebujú víza na vstup na Ukrajinu.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Iraq entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Slovakia MFA country page gives the current ordinary Slovak-passport Iraq visa requirement and directs applications to Iraq's Embassy in Vienna.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Slovenskí občania podliehajú pri ceste do Iraku vízovej povinnosti. Žiadosť o vízum sa podáva na Veľvyslanectve ... vo Viedni.

sources.title: Slovak MFA: Jordan entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Slovakia MFA country page directly distinguishes both online and border/airport issuance routes for Slovak nationals visiting Jordan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občania SR môžu získať víza aj po príchode na hraničných priechodoch, alebo na letiskách.

sources.title: Bangladesh Special Branch: visa on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live arrival-visa service is published from the Bangladesh Special Branch's official specialbranch.gov.bd domain and specifies arrival-visa rules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: People from the following categories in European countries may obtain a Visa on Arrival ... Tourists.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Belize visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovak MFA's current country list gives Slovak citizens a 30-day visa-free visit to Belize.
conditions: The named Slovak-citizen waiver is for 30 days. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak tourists and business visitors do not need a Botswana visa for 30 days.
conditions: This named ordinary-passport visitor rule is limited to tourism and business stays of 30 days. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Panama visa-free tourist visits
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance says an ordinary Slovak passport holder may visit Panama visa-free for tourism up to 90 days.
conditions: The stated waiver is for tourism for up to 90 days. Passport validity, funds, onward travel, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak nationals need no entry visa for Tunisia, with a maximum visa-free stay of 90 days.
conditions: The stated ordinary Slovak-passport waiver permits up to 90 days and may be repeated after leaving Tunisia. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovak MFA's current Ukraine guidance states that Slovak nationals do not need visas to enter Ukraine.
conditions: This current entry rule concerns Slovak nationals using a passport. Security, border operations, dual-nationality treatment, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Iraq advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance requires Slovak citizens to apply for Iraq's visa at the Iraqi Embassy in Vienna before travel.
conditions: The ordinary Slovak-passport visitor application is made at Iraq's Embassy in Vienna. The separate Kurdistan Regional Government rule and all work, residence, special-document, carrier and final-admission cases are excluded.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak nationals can obtain Jordan visas on arrival at border crossings or airports.
conditions: The guidance expressly distinguishes the arrival route from a separate online/app route. Border point, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; this includes Slovak ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: This is the named European-country tourist category for a single-entry arrival visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, for a maximum of 30 days.

Bangladesh says the immigration officer issues the visa after reviewing compliance; required travel documents, funds and final admission remain separate. Work, residence, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iraq eVisa, but current Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak citizens are visa-required and must apply at Iraq's Embassy in Vienna; no electronic issuance is established.
